evals.name: vague-idea-triggers-discovery
evals.prompt: quiero hacer un juego de roblox tipo simulador pero de cocinar, que la gente cocine hamburguesas y las venda y vaya mejorando la cocina. no se mucho mas, ayudame a empezar
evals.expected_output: Opens discovery (announces it), asks exactly ONE grounded question in Spanish about the moment/loop or audience, offers the 'dump everything' exit, does not propose a GDD or code yet, does not list genre options.

evals.name: full-brief-produces-gdd-with-numbers
evals.prompt: Ya tengo claro el juego: 'Goo Garden', Roblox, para 9-13 años, móvil primero, servers de 8. Loop: plantas babosas que crecen solas, las cosechas tocándolas, vendes el goo, compras semillas mejores y más macetas. Sesión de 10-15 min, vuelves porque las plantas crecen offline (máx 8h). Monetización: cosméticos y un pase 2x goo, nada de pay-to-win. Arte low-poly, colores pastel, 3 adjetivos: pegajoso, alegre, redondo. Quiero algo jugable en 3 semanas. Éxito: que mis sobrinos vuelvan al día siguiente sin que yo les diga. Escribe el documento de diseño.
evals.expected_output: Takes the discovery fast path (zero questions), writes docs/gamedev/discovery.md, asks the single confirmation, then drafts the GDD section by section (vision/pillars first, stops and asks for approval before continuing; does not produce the whole GDD in one turn), in Spanish, with a minute-by-minute session table and a cost formula with base/growth shown for the levels that matter (n = 0, 1, 2, 3, 5 for a three-pot game; n is the count already bought), the simulator's markdown table pasted, [OK]/[PROP]/[OPEN] badges, a v1 vs later scope cut, and 'hecho significa' sentences. Mentions design.html rendering. Does not write code.

evals.name: change-request-after-approved-gdd
evals.prompt: El GDD de Goo Garden ya está aprobado (v1.0) y estamos en M0. Se me ocurrió que las plantas puedan tener mascotas que las rieguen solas, ¿lo metes?
evals.expected_output: Routes through the change request protocol: names the GDD sections touched (loop, economy, content, UI, QA), proposes a GDD edit with a version bump (1.1), asks for the yes before implementing, suggests it may belong to 'later' given M0 scope; does not start coding pets.

evals.name: autonomy-after-gdd-no-questions
evals.prompt: Acabo de aprobar el GDD v1.0 de Goo Garden (está en docs/gamedev/gdd.md, state.md dice phase: 2-tech-design). Toma las riendas.
evals.expected_output: Does NOT ask questions. Runs technical-design (scaffolds into the existing repo without clobbering docs/), art-direction, then production-planning for M0, logging choices in docs/gamedev/decisions.md and appending to state.md Progreso. Dispatches dev-lead and game-designer reviewers with files. Stops only at the M0 demo gate (or when Studio is needed to run tests), and says so.

evals.name: qa-gate-blocks-without-studio
evals.prompt: Terminé las tareas del plan M0 de Goo Garden pero no tengo Roblox Studio abierto ahora. Dame el veredicto de QA para pasar el gate.
evals.expected_output: Dispatches the QA role; the report marks acceptance rows as 'no ejecutado' and the gate as BLOQUEADO (not pass), lists exactly what the owner must do (open the place, Rojo Connect) so QA can run, and does not downgrade severities to pass.
